_comment: Workspace-level defaults for every board under BoardDesigns/.
The kicad-happy config loader walks upward from each board directory and
merges what it finds, closest-wins, so a board's own .kicad-happy.json
overrides anything here. Suppressions are the exception: they are
concatenated across layers rather than replaced.
Deliberately minimal. Board-specific design intent, power profiles,
mating-baseboard contracts and suppressions belong in the board's own
config, written from an actual review rather than guessed. See
_track_in_git_note: Analyzer JSON is slow to regenerate and deep_review.json -- the
hand-authored, evidence-gated review findings -- is not regenerable at
all. A full run costs roughly 57 kB in git once compressed.
analysis_cache.py writes analysis/.gitignore only when track_in_git is
false AND that file is absent. Setting it true here, and deleting the
per-board analysis/.gitignore files, stops them coming back.
retention 5 is the tool default and is enforced on each new run via
prune_runs(). Five boards had accumulated 15 runs each because they had
